english_retrieval.snippet:
GST Credit War Erupts: Mamata Banerjee Slams Centre Over Reforms, Claims Credit For Zero Tax
India Today
11300000 subscribers
3 likes
531 views
22 Sep 2025
West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has lashed out at the central government over the credit for new GST reforms, specifically the removal of tax on insurance. Following the rollout, Banerjee stated, “we were the first one to demand removal of GST on insurance,” asserting the central government is incorrectly claiming credit for the move. The criticism followed the Prime Minister's address on the GST rollout. She pointed out that decisions are made by the GST Council, a joint body of the centre and states. Banerjee also highlighted the financial strain on states, claiming West Bengal alone will lose 20,000 crores in revenue.
